description: Synthetic parcel ledger for reproducible App checks, not a benchmark task. The package default seed (fixtures/minimal.json) has 3 parcels. The catalog under fixtures/seeds has 24 further parcels in eight seed scenarios, with six identities, ten addresses (nine verified), six pickup points and six policy profiles. Names, addresses and tracking numbers are fictional and not deliverable.

sources.description: Hand-authored directory records (people, addresses, pickup points, policy profiles, senders, parcel descriptions) and the default seed. Public carrier help pages were read only as workflow references; no text, data, branding or media was copied.

Catalog seed histories (changes, decisions, passes, authorizations, notices, timelines) produced by replaying this App's own operations and trusted events over the authored directory in a fixed order. No random input.

transformations: UTC timestamps on or after 2026-01-01; synthetic IDs; one shared parcel ledger per run with access filtered by the acting person.
Catalog files are regenerated by scripts/build-fixtures.cjs; tests fail if they differ from the generator output.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
